title: KiCad + OpenEMS harness flags PCB signal-integrity issues before fab
summary: Author built a fully open-source KiCad plus OpenEMS physical simulation harness to check PCB signal integrity before sending boards to fabrication; it already flagged issues on their design.
question_it_answers: How can you pre-fab check PCB signal integrity with KiCad and OpenEMS?

claims.text: A custom KiCad plus OpenEMS harness can check signal integrity of a PCB design before fabrication.
claims.evidence: KiCAD+OpenEMS physical simulation harness so that I can check the signal integrity of my PCB design before shipping it off to the fabs.
claims.subject: ai-cad-hardware

claims.text: The harness already flagged signal-integrity problems on the author's board.
claims.evidence: It's already working coz it flagged my board for signal integrity issues
claims.subject: ai-cad-hardware

judge_hints.why_must_read: Harness repo or scripts not linked in tweet; claim is demonstrated but artifact unpublished.
